snippet.title: Overthrown - 1.0 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready, Citizens! 
Overthrown catapults into 1.0 on Steam, Xbox, and PS5 on October 16th! 👑

Lift and throw anything as you build and manage your kingdom in this chaotic city builder with up-to 6-player co-op. 
Harness the power of your soul-stealing crown to partake in anime-style combat, farm the land, gather resources and much more!

Play now in Steam Early Access & Xbox Game Pass:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133500/Overthrown/
Xbox Game Pass: https://bit.ly/3HUSVzX
